messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: release of version 0.3 of NIMBLE
parts:
Dear nimble-users and nimble-announce,

We're pleased to announce that we've put version 0.3 of NIMBLE at
R-nimble.org in time for the new year.

For version 0.3 we want to highlight some changes to the API in terms
of how users create and compile models and algorithms. Please see the
News page on r-nimble.org for a brief summary of these changes and a
link to the more detailed list on github (also available in the NEWS
file in the R package). We believe these changes will enhance the user
experience going forward. In some cases these break backwards
compatibility, but they should only require minor modification to any
existing code you have.

In addition, version 0.3 has faster compiling, notably for MCMC algorithms.

These are still early days for NIMBLE.  Please take a moment to let us
know what you're trying to use it for and what would make it better.
You can email the development team directly at nimble...@gmail.com
or share with the nimble-users list at nimble...@googlegroups.com.

 - Chris Paciorek for the NIMBLE Development Team
